traits.name: Darkvision
traits.desc: You have Darkvision with a range of 60 feet.

traits.name: Celestial Resistance
traits.desc: You have Resistance to Necrotic damage and Radiant damage.

traits.name: Healing Hands
traits.desc: As an action, you touch a creature to restore Hit Points (a number of d4s equal to your level). Once per Long Rest.

traits.name: Celestial Revelation
traits.desc: Starting at level 3, you gain a transformation determined by your chosen lineage (subrace).
